What IT can learn from botnets


     This week, I had phone conversation with Josh Corman about botnets. Corman is the host protection architect for Internet Security Systems Inc. with more than eight years of experience in security and networking software. What was refreshing was Corman's out-of-the-box thinking on the distributed networks currently being used by online criminals. Of the most popular of these networks, he said "Storm did a lot of things right; in some ironic sort of way, you could argue that Storm is itself a blueprint for fighting (botnets)." Read more
